map.Softmax 概率转换器，将一组 logits 归一化为概率分布(和为1)，用: Softmax Probability Converter: normalizes a set of logits into a probability distribution summing to 1, used to turn a multiclass model output layer into probabilities.
map.Softmax 把 logits 变成和为 1 的概率分布，指数放大差距使最大值: Softmax turns logits into a probability distribution summing to 1, and the exponential amplifies gaps so the maximum stands out. In practice max(z) is subtracted before exponentiating to avoid overflow; the output probabilities are not the same as model confidence, and uncalibrated models are often overconfident.
map.softmax(z)_i=exp(z_i)/Σⱼexp(z_j)，将 logit: softmax(z)_i=exp(z_i)/Σⱼexp(z_j) normalizes logits into a probability distribution summing to 1.
map.输出具平移不变性(全体加常数不变)，但对尺度敏感(乘系数放大差异)。: The output is shift invariant (adding a constant to all logits changes nothing) but sensitive to scale (multiplying amplifies the differences).
map.多分类输出层标配，配合交叉熵作损失；数值上先减最大值防溢出。: Standard for multiclass output layers, paired with cross-entropy loss; numerically the maximum is subtracted first to prevent overflow.
map.：logits=[2,1,0.1]，减最大值 2 得 [0,−1,−1.9]，e: : logits=[2,1,0.1]; subtracting the maximum 2 gives [0,−1,−1.9], exp=[1,0.368,0.149], Σ=1.517 → probabilities=[0.659,0.243,0.098], summing to 1.
map.exp 大数会溢出。softmax 具平移不变性，先减最大值不改变结果却把所有指: exp overflows for large numbers. Softmax is shift invariant, so subtracting the maximum leaves the result unchanged while pushing all exponents to ≤0, which avoids exp overflow and keeps the computation stable.
map.softmax 和 sigmoid 在二分类下等价吗？: Are Softmax and Sigmoid Equivalent for Binary Classification?
map.等价。二分类 softmax 两维概率互为补数，与对单 logit 用 sigm: Equivalent. For binary classification the two softmax probabilities are complementary, matching sigmoid applied to a single logit; softmax normalization is only required for multiclass problems.
